content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in knowing if it is possible to set up the Data Log function to save readings to a microSD card. I need to log sensor temperature values every 5 minutes over a period of 24 to 48 hours, totalling around 288 to 576 records. If I use EEPROM, there may not be enough space for all values. Is it possible to store them directly on the microSD card? Additionally, if the logs fill the EEPROM, does the system overwrite the oldest entries first or does it simply stop recording?
Have you checked the manual for further details?
Thank you, this answers my question perfectly.

analysis.insight_summary: The user needed to record periodic sensor data for up to 48 hours using the Data Log feature on [product_name], and was uncertain about logging directly to microSD because of EEPROM space limits. The user also sought clarification on how old log data is handled when storage runs out, showing some confusion about memory management on the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the device to offer reliable extended data logging directly to microSD and wants explicit detail on how much data can be stored as well as how older records are handled when the memory becomes full.
